name: gap_continuation_momentum_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: When NIFTY opens with a gap >0.3% driven by overnight global cues (US futures, Asian markets, SGX Nifty), the gap reflects pre-positioned FII and domestic institutional orders that need intraday execution. If after 20 minutes of trading the gap is holding — NIFTY close remains above the session open for a gap-up — VWAP-benchmarked institutional algorithms are net directional buyers, continuously absorbing counter-trend flow. At 5-second resolution, these resting buy programs create periodic micro-continuation pulses: each brief 30-60 second pullback in price is quickly absorbed, generating 10-20 NIFTY spot point resumption moves. We enter at the onset of these micro-pulses using 1-minute positive momentum as the trigger, capturing the option premium expansion as NIFTY resumes its gap direction.

indicators.name: gap_pct
indicators.purpose: Day-level gap detection using NIFTY session open vs prior session's last close. Threshold 0.3% — much smaller than the original's 1.5% equity threshold because indices are less volatile; a 0.3% NIFTY gap represents ~60-70 spot points, a meaningful overnight information signal from global markets. Not scaled from the original — this is a fixed economic threshold set to NIFTY's volatility profile, not a bars calculation.

indicators.name: gap_holding
indicators.formula: close > session_open (gap-up) OR close < session_open (gap-down), checked after 09:35
indicators.purpose: Bar-by-bar confirmation that the gap is not being filled. Replaces the original's structural check (bar-15 close > high of bars 1-5). After 09:35 IST, if NIFTY close stays above the session open on a gap-up day, institutional VWAP algorithms are net buyers and the gap-continuation thesis remains active. Dynamically turns off if the gap fills mid-morning, preventing false entries.

indicators.name: mom_12
indicators.purpose: 1-minute (12 bars × 5s) micro-momentum to time entry within the gap-continuation regime. 12 bars chosen because our hold time is 30-90 seconds — entering on fresh 1-min positive momentum means we are catching the micro-continuation onset, not chasing a move already 2-3 minutes old. Longer lookbacks (36-60 bars) would lag too much; shorter (6 bars) would be too noisy at 5s.

conditions: gap_pct > 0.003 (NIFTY gapped up >0.3% from prior session close)
close > session_open (gap still holding, not being filled by sellers)
VIX < 22 (low fear regime; high-VIX gap days often see sharp reversals)
buy_ce.confirmation: All conditions simultaneously true on a single 5s bar

conditions: gap_pct < -0.003 (NIFTY gapped down >0.3% from prior session close)
close < session_open (gap-down still holding, no recovery)
buy_pe.confirmation: All conditions simultaneously true on a single 5s bar

exit.stop_rationale: 3 option points = ~6 NIFTY spot points at delta 0.5. A gap-continuation micro-pulse driven by institutional VWAP flow should not retrace 6 spot points within 30-90 seconds; if it does, either the gap is filling or a counter-macro event has shifted institutional order direction. Exit immediately — the regime is no longer valid.
exit.target_rationale: 5 option points = ~10 NIFTY spot points. Gap-continuation micro-pulses on NIFTY average 10-20 spot points per pulse at 1-2 minute timescales; targeting 10 pts captures the conservative lower half of that range at 1:1.67 R:R, achievable within our 30-90 second hold window without requiring the full continuation leg.
exit.eod_rule: flatten at 13:00 IST (no new entries; afternoon sessions see more two-way flow as institutional execution winds down)

filters.vix_filter: VIX < 22; gap days with elevated VIX (>22) frequently see institutional selling into the gap, reversing the continuation thesis
filters.time_filter: 09:35-13:00 IST; first 20 min is the confirmation window, afternoon sessions have less directional institutional flow
filters.volume_filter: not applied explicitly; index volume at 5s is noisy and gap_holding provides the same filtering function
filters.trend_filter: gap direction IS the trend filter — only trade in the direction of the opening gap
filters.spread_filter: not applicable; limit order execution at 5s close prices, no bid-ask spread cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — gap-continuation days driven by global macro flows are persistent; institutional VWAP execution creates predictable micro-pulses that are difficult to front-run at 5s latency

adaptation_notes: Original: NIFTY 200 stock universe, gap >1.5%, 15-min structural confirmation (bar-15 > high of bars 1-5), 30-90 min hold, VWAP + volume filters. Key changes: (1) Gap threshold 1.5%→0.3% because NIFTY index is ~5x less volatile than individual stocks intraday. (2) Structural confirmation replaced by bar-by-bar gap-holding check (close vs session_open after 09:35) — more responsive at 5s and avoids discrete bar lookups. (3) Added 1-min micro-momentum trigger (mom_12) to time entry within the gap regime, replacing the original's single entry at 09:30. (4) Hold time compressed from 30-90 min to 30-90 seconds — we trade the micro-continuation pulses, not the full intraday trend. (5) Stock-specific filters (delivery volume, catalyst type, ADV, bid-ask spread %) replaced with VIX regime filter only, appropriate for index trading.
weaknesses: Gap conditions (>0.3% held past 09:35) occur on only ~30-40% of trading days; zero-trade days are common
On strong gap-up days, aggressive sellers quickly fill the gap before 09:35, disabling the strategy for the entire session
Using session_open as the fill-detection level is imprecise — a transient dip below open and recovery resets the gap_holding signal, potentially missing valid continuation bars
1-minute momentum trigger may fire too late on high-velocity gap mornings where the micro-pulse is already 2-3 minutes old at entry
